Population increased in Bexley

The estimated population of Bexley in 2024 was 256,434 usual residents, a rise of 1.7% since 2023.

This meant that Bexley's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Bexley increased by 4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Bexley was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Bexley

The average (median) age fell to 39.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Bexley has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Bexley is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Bexley's population of 256,434 usual residents was made up of:

  • 51,912 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.2%)
  • 162,071 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.2%)
  • 42,451 people aged 65 years and over, (16.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Bexley has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (16.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Bexley, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Bexley
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Bexley, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 518 people (0.2%). In total, there were 2,636 births and 2,118 deaths in Bexley.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 572 (0.2%). There were 17,938 people entering the area and 17,366 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Bexley's population of 3,210 (1.3%) as a result of 4,476 people entering the area and 1,266 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Bexley was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Bexley in mid-2023 is 252,124.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,473 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 202 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,271 people.
